Friday, 30 May 2025

Day in brief

30 May 2025: documentation-heavy day, with Entra CBA CRL behavior clarified and Global Secure Access TLS inspection guidance updated

The supplied record contains 1,974 updates, with no new or removed items and no Message Center announcements. It therefore does not evidence a broad launch, general-availability event, or retirement. The meaningful exceptions are a Certificate-based Authentication behavior note, updated Global Secure Access TLS inspection (Preview) instructions, refreshed security guidance for application identifier URIs, and a Workload ID service-principal setup clarification. Most other sampled entries are partner-specific SSO and provisioning how-to updates.

  • Entra ID · Authentication
    Entra ID Certificate-based Authentication: CRL handling is documented more clearly

    The updated What's New Archive states that a CA can be uploaded without a CRL endpoint and that certificate-based authentication will not fail when an issuing CA has no CRL specified. Treat this as a documented behavior clarification in the period—not proof of a new launch—and recheck CBA designs that depend on a CRL being present.

  • Global Secure Access · Security
    Global Secure Access TLS inspection guidance updated (Preview)

    The updated configuration article describes how to configure a TLS inspection policy and assign it to users. The capability is explicitly marked Preview; the supplied evidence does not indicate general availability or a new rollout. Administrators testing it should review the policy and assignment procedure.

  • Entra ID · Security
    Entra application identifier URI guidance received a security refresh

    The updated security page reiterates that identifierUri, or Application ID URI, is typically configured on resource/API applications and that secure configuration is critical to the resource's security. The supplied summary does not identify a new restriction or enforcement change, so this supports a review of current guidance rather than tenant-wide remediation.

  • Workload ID · Developer
    Workload ID service-principal guidance clarifies subscription role assignment

    The updated portal how-to states that an application must be assigned a role through the Azure portal to access subscription resources and points administrators to Azure built-in roles. This is ordinary setup documentation, not evidence of a new Workload ID permission model; include the role-assignment step when following the procedure.

This period briefing was generated by AI from the tracked Microsoft Learn and Message Center changes.

Customer intent: As an IT administrator, I want to learn how to automatically provision and deprovision user accounts from Microsoft Entra ID to Atmo…

Updated

This article describes the steps you need to do in both Atmos and Microsoft Entra ID to configure automatic user provisioning. When configured, Microsoft Entra ID automatically provisions and de-provisions users and groups to [Atmos](https://www.axissecurity.com/) using the Microsoft Entra provisioning service. For important details on what this service does, how it works, and frequently asked questions, see [Automate user provisioning and deprovisioning to SaaS applications with Microsoft Entra ID](~/identity/app-provisioning/user-provisioning.md).
